page: /de/events/ + /de/events/<slug>/ (EventsView.astro block de; EventDetailView.astro block de; TEXT_DE in src/data/events.ts; eventsTable caption in tables.ts)
part: Batch 1 of 5 — index page chrome: hero, notice, card labels, status badges, countdown, tips, CTA, table caption

ix.eyebrow.context: Index page hero: small eyebrow line above the H1 (2–4 words; uppercased by CSS — do not write capitals).

ix.title.context: Index page H1 («Festivals & Events»); also the breadcrumb label of this page and the second breadcrumb on every single-event page. The published header/footer nav label for this page is nav.events = «Termine» (not editable here, see context). The H1 may differ from the nav label, as it does in English («Events» vs «Festivals & Events»).

ix.lead.en: From Qaisariyah Souq to the palm groves, Al-Ahsa pulses with seasons that revive its heritage all year round — celebrations and festivals that return each year in their season.
ix.lead.ar: من سوق القيصرية إلى مزارع النخيل، تنبض الأحساء بمواسمَ تُحيي تراثها على مدار العام — احتفالاتٌ ومهرجاناتٌ تعود كلَّ سنةٍ في موسمها.
ix.lead.context: Hero lead paragraph under the H1 (≈60ch column). Names: Qaisariyah Souq = published «der Qaisariyah-Souk».

ix.notice.en: These events recur annually in their approximate seasons; official dates and details may vary from year to year with each edition. Please confirm via the organisers’ announcements and official channels before visiting.
ix.notice.ar: تتكرّر هذه الفعاليات سنوياً في مواسمها التقريبية، وقد تختلف مواعيدها وتفاصيلها من عامٍ لآخر بحسب تنظيم كل نسخة. يُرجى التأكد من إعلانات الجهات المنظّمة والقنوات الرسمية قبل الزيارة.
ix.notice.context: FIRST paragraph of the page body, directly under the hero, above the event cards. BINDING OWNER RULE (CLAUDE.md): because the German nav label is «Termine» (which promises fixed dates), the top of /de/events/ MUST say explicitly that the dates are approximate — this paragraph carries that statement; keep it explicit and unmissable (e.g. «ungefähr»/«ungefähren»), without inventing anything beyond the source.

ix.placeK.context: Label (dt) on every event card before the venue; also the 2nd column header of the events table under the cards; reused as the same label on single-event pages. One word.

ix.mapK.context: Small link after the venue on a card: opens Google Maps in a new tab. Keep the arrow ↗.

ix.ticketK.context: Button on a card (and on the single-event page) linking to the official booking page — only shown for an edition that sells tickets. Imperative, Sie.

ix.orgK.context: Label (dt) on every card before the organising bodies (several cards list 2–3 bodies). Also used on single-event pages.

ix.spanK.context: Label for the approximate duration («A few days», «Several weeks») — used on single-event pages next to «Season» and «When».

ix.actsK.context: H3 above the bullet list of activities on each card (and H2 on single-event pages). Denglisch rule: «Highlight» at most once per page — prefer a German word.

ix.statusL.confirmed.context: Status badge on a card photo: the organiser officially announced this year’s dates. Very short badge.

ix.statusL.expected.context: Status badge (most cards): season expected by analogy with past editions — no official date. Very short badge, parallel to the other two.

ix.statusL.tba.context: Status badge: recurrence not yet announced. Very short badge, parallel to the other two.

ix.cd.pre.one.context: Countdown badge filled by JavaScript from the visitor’s device date, when exactly 1 day is left before an announced edition starts. German plural form «one» (n = 1); may contain {n} or not — English says «tomorrow».

ix.cd.pre.other.context: Countdown badge, n ≠ 1 days before the start. Keep the placeholder {n} literally (replaced by a Western-digit number).

ix.cd.today.context: Countdown badge on the opening day.

ix.cd.last.context: Countdown badge on the closing day of an edition.

ix.cd.left.one.context: Countdown badge during an edition: exactly 1 day left (German plural form «one»).

ix.cd.left.other.context: Countdown badge during an edition: n ≠ 1 days left. Keep {n} literally.

ix.nowBadge.context: Badge on the card of whatever event is running in the current month (JS, device date). Arabic «نحن الآن هنا» = «we are here now» on a timeline — i.e. «this is the current season». Very short badge.

ix.orderNote.en: The cards are ordered automatically by what is nearest to your device’s date — starting with whatever is under way now.
ix.orderNote.ar: رُتِّبت البطاقات تلقائياً حسب الأقرب إلى تاريخ جهازك — تبدأ بما هو جارٍ الآن.
ix.orderNote.context: Small note above the cards, shown only after JavaScript re-orders them by closeness to the device date.

ix.notesH.context: H2 of the three-tip section below the cards; the SAME string is the heading of the notice box on every single-event page.

ix.notes.0.h.context: H3 of tip 1 («Timing»); ALSO the 3rd column header of the events table (the cells read «Winter · Around December»). One word.

ix.notes.0.d.en: The events follow both the Hijri and Gregorian calendars and return annually in their approximate seasons; official dates can shift from year to year — follow each edition’s announcements.
ix.notes.0.d.ar: تتبع الفعاليات التقويمين الهجري والميلادي وتعود سنوياً في مواسمها التقريبية، وقد تختلف المواعيد الرسمية من عامٍ لآخر — تابع إعلانات كل نسخة.
ix.notes.0.d.context: Tip 1 text. Hijri calendar: gloss rule of the termbase applies (first mention on the page).

ix.notes.1.d.en: The festivals spotlight Al-Ahsa’s identity and heritage through folk dress, handicrafts and authentic local products.
ix.notes.1.d.ar: تسلّط المهرجانات الضوء على هوية الأحساء وتراثها عبر الملابس الشعبية والحرف اليدوية والمنتجات المحلية الأصيلة.

ix.notes.2.d.en: Programmes suit the whole family, focused on entertainment, creativity, shopping and tasting for all ages.
ix.notes.2.d.ar: برامج تناسب جميع أفراد العائلة، بتركيزٍ على الترفيه والإبداع والتسوق والتذوق لكل الأعمار.

ix.srcNote.en: For more information and updates, follow Al-Ahsa Municipality, the Al-Ahsa Development Authority and the events’ official channels.
ix.srcNote.ar: للمزيد من المعلومات والتحديثات، يُرجى متابعة أمانة الأحساء وهيئة تطوير الأحساء والقنوات الرسمية للفعاليات.
ix.srcNote.context: Small closing note under the tips. Bodies by their termbase names (Al-Ahsa Municipality = «die Kommunalverwaltung von Al-Ahsa»; Al-Ahsa Development Authority — search the termbase; if absent, stage 4 sources it).

ix.ctaH.en: Turn your season into a full trip
ix.ctaH.context: H2 of the closing call-to-action band.

ix.ctaD.en: Pair the festival with the oasis sights around it, and build your route in “My Trip”.
ix.ctaD.ar: اربط زيارة المهرجان بمعالم الواحة القريبة منه، وجهّز مسارك في «رحلتي».
ix.ctaD.context: CTA paragraph. «My Trip» = the published German label of the favourites feature (see neighbours: nav.myTrip or similar) — quote it exactly as published.

ix.ctaBrowse.context: CTA button 1 → /de/attractions/. Short, imperative or noun phrase, parallel to button 2.

ix.ctaPlan.context: CTA button 2 → the (English) trip-planning page. Must match the published German label of the plan link (see neighbours nav.plan / nav.planVisit).

tbl.caption.en: Seasonal calendar of events — approximate, recurring annually
tbl.caption.ar: روزنامة مواسم الفعاليات — مواعيد تقريبية تعود سنوياً
tbl.caption.context: Caption of the events table below the cards (rows: event · venue · «season · time»). The source dash — ⇒ U+2013 with spaces. Must keep «approximate» explicit.
